title: Cokernels of maps between finite-presentation modules are finite presentation
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space, let $\mathcal G,\mathcal H$ be sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $f:\mathcal G\to\mathcal H$ be $\mathcal O_X$-linear. If $\mathcal G$ is of finite type (locally a quotient of $\mathcal O_X^{\oplus m}$ with $m$ finite) and $\mathcal H$ is of finite presentation (locally the cokernel of $\mathcal O_X^{\oplus r}\to\mathcal O_X^{\oplus n}$ with $r,n$ finite), then the cokernel of $f$ in $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ is of finite presentation. In particular this holds when both $\mathcal G$ and $\mathcal H$ are of finite presentation.
